data.name: Rasil
data.gender_notes: Rasil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who delivers a message or sends a reminder to others. The name Rasil carries the meaning “Messenger, Emissary” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rasil usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger, emissary and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is meant to bring guidance and reminders to others
data.etymology: Rasil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Messenger, Emissary.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rasil total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: راسل
in_arabic.meaning: مرسل، رسول، کسی کا پیغام لانے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: راسل کا مطلب ہے مرسل یا رسول، جو کسی کا پیغام لانے والا ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربى جڑوں سے نکلا ہے اور اسلامی تقليد میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ رسول اللہ (صلى الله عليه وسلم) کی خصوصيتوں میں سے ایک ہے۔ اس نام کا انتخاب کرنے والے والدین اپنے بچے کے لیے ایک اعلیٰ مقصد اور رسالت کی خواہش کا اظہار کرتے ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: راسل
in_urdu.meaning: مرسل، پیغامبر، کسی کا پیغام لانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: راسل نام کا مطلب مرسل یا پیغامبر ہوتا ہے، جو کسی کا پیغام لانے والا ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی روایت میں اس کا بڑا مقام ہے۔ اس نام کے انتخاب کا مطلب ہے کہ والدین اپنے بچے کے لئے ایک اعلیٰ مقصد اور رسالت کی خواہش رکھتے ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रासिल
in_hindi.long_meaning: रासिल नाम का अर्थ है संदेशवाहक या दूत। यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से निकला है और इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है। इस नाम का चयन करने वाले माता-पिता अपने बच्चे के लिए एक उच्च उद्देश्य और सन्देशवाहक की इच्छा व्यक्त करते हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर अच्छे गुणों के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

in_english.name: Rasil
in_english.meaning: Messenger, envoy, one who conveys a message
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rasil originates from Arabic roots and signifies a messenger, envoy, or one who conveys a message. In Islamic tradition, it holds significant importance as it relates to the role of prophets and messengers. Parents choosing this name often aspire for their child to embody qualities of guidance, communication, and leadership. The name Rasil is used across various Muslim cultures and is valued for its spiritual and historical connotations.

This can be applied to various aspects of life such as being a teacher, a mentor, a messenger of good news, or a bearer of wisdom and guidance. In essence, the name represents the importance of communication and service to others within the Islamic context.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper, spiritual level, the name Rasil signifies the role of every believer in carrying the message of Allah (swt) to others. It emphasizes the significance of conveying His word and spreading knowledge, love, and comfort to those around us. In Islamic teachings, this role is regarded as an honor and privilege granted by Allah. By embodying the attributes of being a Rasil, one may feel a sense of connection and purpose in their faith, knowing that they are contributing to the greater good of society and the spread of knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Messenger, Emissary" symbolizes One who delivers a message or sends a reminder to others. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Rasil serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of messenger, emissary.
